settings.heading: Protection that switches itself on, so you never have to remember it.
settings.lede: For busy households and anyone managing a parent’s or a second home from afar: schedules, geofencing and every device in one free app. No monitoring subscription, and nothing to renew.
settings.image_alt: Close-up of the Kevin 3 fabric front and controls
settings.cta_heading: One device, one app, no subscription.
settings.cta_subheading: Buy Kevin outright with free shipping across the EU, 30-day returns and a 3-year Swiss warranty.

settings.heading: Decide once how your home should behave. Kevin takes it from there.
settings.body: The app is where you set the routine. After that, Kevin runs without taps, reminders or a monthly fee.

settings.image_alt: Weekly schedule screen in the Kevin app
settings.title: Weekly schedules
settings.body: Set weekdays, weekends and holidays once. Kevin follows the plan so the house looks lived-in at the hours that matter, whether you remember or not.

settings.image_alt: Geofencing setting in the Kevin app
settings.title: Geofencing
settings.body: Kevin starts when your phone leaves the area around your home and stops when you come back. The daily leave-and-forget routine without touching anything.

settings.image_alt: Several Kevin devices listed in the app
settings.title: Every home in one app
settings.body: Your own home, a parent’s flat, the holiday house, the office: add a Kevin to each and check or adjust any of them from wherever you are.

settings.title: Your household, your sounds
settings.body: Record dinner, the kids or the dog in the app. Kevin mixes your recordings with its 70+ hours of built-in scenes, so your home sounds like your home. Built-in voices come in English, German and Swiss German.

settings.title: Nothing is watched or streamed
settings.body: The app sends settings to Kevin. Kevin has no camera and no microphone, and every scene plays from its own 32 GB storage. There is no video feed, no cloud recording and nothing for anyone else to see.

settings.heading: Pair once after unboxing.
settings.body: Download the app, connect Kevin over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and choose a routine. The app is available in English, German, French and Dutch.

settings.title: Download the Kevin app
settings.body: For iOS and Android. Search for Kevin by Mitipi in your app store.

settings.title: Pair your device
settings.body: Follow the in-app guide to connect Kevin over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Give it a name such as “Living room” or “Mum’s flat”.

settings.title: Choose a routine
settings.body: Start a simulation now, set the weekly schedule, or switch on geofencing. Change it any time from wherever you are.
